document_type: DRAFT field crosswalk for the rule-record draft. Build plan section 4 item 2 is the report-representation and field-mapping register; this crosswalk is the rule-record draft's own reading of that register plus the measured PHASE5-001I-A extraction, and it creates no new register entry
purpose: state, field by field, exactly which printed facts this rule unit reads, what each is mapped to, what each must never be used as, and which printed fields are deliberately not mapped - so that no reader can mistake a printed collection field for an admitted tradeline fact, or a report reference date for a statutory or event date
evidence_the_mapping_is_read_from: SOURCE_CAPTURES\PROD-003\report_representation_register.json field_records FACT-02, FACT-03, FACT-04, FACT-05 and date_meanings, explicit_blanks, unresolved_mappings
SOURCE_CAPTURES\PROD-003\extraction_evidence.json (the named extraction method and its measured values)
SOURCE_CAPTURES\PHASE5-001I-A\extraction_results.json (the measured run: admission predicates, section resolution, record binding, per-record values)
SOURCE_CAPTURES\PHASE5-001I-A\locators.cjs and presentation-contract.cjs (the implemented locators and admission predicates; internal, rank 8)
internal-validation\ca-ns-last-payment-six-year\constants.cjs (the status vocabulary and the printed date form)

mapped_facts.prints_in: a contract debt record inside the Collections section
locators: record 1: page 16, line 32 (record spans page 16 line 8 to page 16 line 38)
record 2: page 17, line 5 (record spans page 16 line 39 to page 17 line 11)
mapped_facts.drafted_fact_definition: the date the printed collection record states the last payment on that debt was made, bound to that record
mapped_facts.date_meaning_as_recorded: the date the printed record states the last payment was made; a report-stated historical event the report asserts, not proof that the payment occurred
mapped_facts.divergence: the admitted legacy rule record requires a tradeline field, while this presentation prints the field on a collection record. The legacy corpus's own record states that a collection carries no such field and that neither a collection's opened date nor its reported date answers either limb
resolution_required_at_admission: an owner/corpus amendment seating the printed collection field as the representation of the required field, or
a determination that the printed field does not satisfy the admitted field requirement, in which case the first limb has no admitted representation on this presentation
must_never_be_used_as: a tradeline fact without an owner/corpus determination
proof that any payment was made
a value borrowed from another record, section or page
mapped_facts.confidence_and_boundary: demonstrated on one specimen; a second specimen is required before the locator is called reusable (D-2)

mapped_facts.prints_in: the page header, line 1 of every page
mapped_facts.locator: page-header label on all 22 pages, line 1 of each page
mapped_facts.drafted_fact_definition: the date the consumer requested the report, as printed by the bureau in the page header
mapped_facts.date_meaning_as_recorded: the report's request date, printed by the bureau
mapped_facts.role_in_the_rule: the comparison reference date, and the only point in time this unit compares against
mapped_facts.convention_note: the admitted text names no comparison date. Its use here is a modelling convention of the internal evaluation, recorded for admission, not a requirement of the accepted text
must_never_be_used_as: a statutory effective date or a commencement date
the date of any underlying event, including the last payment or a default
evidence that anything is reportable or that any period has run for statutory purposes
mapped_facts.reading_rule: read from the page header only, and only when the same value appears on every page; two different header values leave it unresolved and the comparison does not run

printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.observed_value: printed with a value inside the collection record
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.why: the admitted text does not read this field as the default-in-payment date, so it may not be substituted for FACT-05. The register records it as a located field whose meaning is NOT the meaning the rule requires
it is the date the record states the debt was assigned to the collection agency; it is not a clock start for either limb

printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.observed_value: printed with no value on this specimen
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.why: no value is printed, and a blank is a resolved reading of THIS specimen's layout only. Even with a value it is not a field the admitted text reads

printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.observed_value: printed with no value on this specimen
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.why: same as Date Paid/Settled; also not read by the admitted text
an account's opening date is neither a last-payment date nor a default date

printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.observed_value: printed with no value on this specimen (Collections)
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.why: explicit blanks recorded by the register; no rule reads them

printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.printed_field: Service Type Details, Date Reported, Compliance Date
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.observed_value: labels printed in the multi-row alerts/disclosures table on page 21
printed_fields_deliberately_not_mapped.why: the named extraction method paired no value with those labels on the same line, so no field from that table is claimed

facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.fact: whether any payment was made on the debt
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.recorded_as_required_by: the legacy rule record's externalFactsRequired, first entry
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.why: no report field carries it, and no printed date proves or disproves it
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.effect: the second limb cannot be evaluated on this presentation; nothing may be defaulted from another printed date

facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.fact: the date on which the default in payment occurred (register FACT-05)
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.recorded_as_required_by: the admitted text's second limb, and the legacy rule record's externalFactsRequired, second entry
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.why: the record prints Date Assigned, First Delinquency, Date Paid/Settled, Date Verified and Last Payment Date, and none of them is that date as the admitted text reads that limb
facts_required_by_the_admitted_text_that.effect: the second limb stays UNSEATED. This is a statement about this specimen's row set, not a statement that no report states such a date

status_and_outcome_are_separate_fields.rule: a status is never an outcome and an outcome is never a status; no comparison runs while either fact is unresolved; neither is a finding
status_and_outcome_are_separate_fields.absent_from_report_reachability: exactly one path: the section is located and resolved and prints no contract debt record

what_this_crosswalk_refuses: reading a label outside a contract debt record
borrowing a date from another record, section or page
treating a blank, missing or malformed label as ABSENT_FROM_REPORT
treating a non-debt region as a debt record
using a report's printed content to select a jurisdiction
mapping a printed collection field to the admitted tradeline field without an owner/corpus determination
claiming any field of the page-21 alerts/disclosures table
unresolved_mapping_questions: whether the printed collection Last Payment Date is the representation of the admitted required field tradeline.lastPaymentDate - OWNER_DECISION
whether the report's request date is the comparison reference date, or another point in time is required - PENDING_ADMISSION
whether the second limb ever gets a presentation - no field is located today; a later presentation must be separately evidenced (D-1)
whether a second specimen confirms the locator - D-2
boundaries: this crosswalk is a draft for the rule-record order. It adds no register entry, admits no fact model, creates no rule and is not gate evidence
it maps only printed positions that PHASE5-001I-A measured on the evidenced specimen, and it treats an unmapped field as unmapped rather than as absent
